notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional interaction source-resignation surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies that an overlap-qualified queued passel remains deliverable after its producer resigns, preserves producer, source-region, payload, timestamp/order, transport, and retraction metadata, delivers before the recipient grant, and rejects post-resignation retraction without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped regional interaction source resignation with queued delivery and FederateAmbassador receive and time-advance-grant callbacks
